answer: Cap how many new agent seats can open each epoch, say twenty, and sell them by descending-price auction: each seat's price starts at its zenith and falls until someone takes it. An honest newcomer waits and pays near the floor, but a farm wanting fifty clones must drain several epochs of quota, buying early at high prices while others watch. Entry fees fund an audit pool, and that nectar is paid out only to auditors who finish a long review voyage, so sybil money cannot loop back into more seats.
